name: Algerian Saharan Arabic
notes:
REGISTRY STUB (not a modelled G2P target). Placed so the ancestry graph covers every living ISO 639-3 language. No orthography or phonology is claimed: script is Zyyy (undetermined) until a cited description is encoded. Classification and coordinates follow Glottolog.

RESOLVES TO ITS PARENT'S TABLE, WHICH IS A PLACEHOLDER. This spec declared a parent and no `graphemes_base`, so it produced no phonology at all and the code resolved to an empty table — a caller asking for it got nothing, silently. It now inherits, so the code reaches a usable table. That table is the parent's and is NOT a claim about this variety: no reflex here has been checked against a source. `quality` stays `stub` for exactly that reason. Replace the inherited table with cited reflexes before treating any reading here as this variety's. Graphemes inherited from ar-DZ because the Algerian Sahara is in Algeria.
